geometryHashEncoding: SHA256 of JSON sorted keys, compact separators, UTF8 and trailing LF
limitations: Display line LOD only; it does not change or claim exact fine polygon fill boundaries.
The configured Mercator DP budget excludes vector-tile quantization and pitched-view perspective; delivery verifier audits those separately.
Simplified province and micro lines are the only internal boundary presentation at every zoom. Operational fronts and national/coast geometry remain authoritative.

policy.closedLoopGuard: Original closed individual-edge rings retain validity, nonzero exact-dyadic signed shoelace area and winding in native and EPSG3857 coordinates.
policy.closedLoopNestingGuard: Every fixed original internal endpoint retains its interior/boundary/exterior relationship to each changed closed arc in native and EPSG3857 coordinates.
policy.continuousDeviationBasis: For each retained chord, every original subchain vertex is within the finite-segment distance bound. Identical endpoints, convexity along each original segment and continuous longitudinal projection bound both continuous polyline directions. IEEE-double measured values are independently rechecked; no gameplay numeric tolerance changes.
policy.displayUse: single simplified representation at every zoom
policy.endpointStarGuard: Cyclic port order and exact ray-tie sets at every original internal-edge endpoint are identical in native and EPSG3857 coordinates. Protected country/coast edge interior vertices contribute both ray ports. Angular predicates use exact dyadic Fraction arithmetic; no angular epsilon.
policy.retainedArcRetry: Each rejected arc retries seven halved budgets, with optional fixed original junction rays, against the current accepted network. Every accepted retry preserves all original pair contacts, endpoint stars, loop nesting and the global deviation bound.
policy.retainedNativeCoordinates: exact ordered original vertex subsequence; never inverse-projected
policy.topologyGuard: Exact normalized intersection geometry of every selected-selected and selected-protected country/coast pair is identical to baseline in both CRS84 and EPSG3857. Related simplified arcs revert in full until stable.

provinceChangeFromPrevious.method: New combined-network safety may restore or retain more original province vertices; original province-only artifact and proof remain unchanged.

sourceBasis.method: All accepted CHN internal arcs share one offline simplification/topology pass; source identities and resolution are unchanged. Province membership follows the pinned presentation index, with remaining arcs delivered as debug micro boundaries.
sourceBasis.temporalLimitation: The original metadata claims 2017, but original shapefile XML records append/dissolve processing in August 2021. The fixed file is mixed or uncertified vintage. It is used as an experimental county geometry reference for the 2020-01-01 game scenario, not certified 2020 or untouched 2017 administrative truth. No unverified change is backdated.
